components.text: Mixue grew its store count 20.7% in the first half, yet revenue rose just 2.3%. Chain tea shops have shrunk for two years, and subsidy-inflated volume is unwinding. Only coffee and breakfast are paying off so far. **Make same-store growth the first target for 2027.**

footnote: Source: Mixue Group interim results (Aug 2026), China Insights Consultancy, 2026 New Tea Drinks White Paper (Mar 2026)
notes: This is the conclusion of the whole review. The three groups of evidence that follow answer three questions: can more stores still deliver growth, what held up 2025 volume, and which new growth paths are already showing results.
